comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep accepted directories compatible with matrix ownership**

When the planner emits one of the newly supported broad scopes such as `src/` or `tests/`, this branch accepts it because the normalized directory root is not itself protected. Later, `writePreparedMatrixPlan` supplies every protected path as `prohibited_paths` (`main.ts:1614-1619`), while `assertNoOverlap` treats a directory and any protected descendant as overlapping (`matrix.ts:109-120`). Since both example directories contain protected files, matrix preparation throws before any implementation cell can run; the validation and matrix ownership representation need compatible semantics for directories with excluded protected descendants.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Apply the dependency gate to retained checkpoints**

When a retained checkpoint was created from a frozen plan that ignored an incoming open dependency, `context.checkpoint` is non-null and this condition skips the new deterministic gate. The retained-plan path authenticates and returns the frozen triage without calling `validatePlannedIssueTriage`, so an unchanged open prerequisite can still proceed to implementation and delivery after the retry becomes due. Evaluate the current captured dependency state for retained work as well, while preserving the checkpoint when it remains blocked.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
